methods.name: Season-matched land-cover change
methods.why: Compare annual land-cover proportions inside village buffers and validate against reference imagery.
methods.tools: Google Earth Engine and QGIS; YCGS consultation

methods.name: Spatial malaria analysis
methods.why: Compare land-cover change with independently observed malaria outcomes while accounting for rainfall, population, interventions and spatial dependence.

methods.name: Sensitivity and uncertainty checks
methods.why: Test buffer sizes and classification accuracy; avoid treating coarse modeled malaria estimates as independent village measurements.

next_steps: Validate village locations and define a consistent buffer distance.
Request geolocated or appropriately aggregated malaria surveillance data from local health authorities; protect privacy.
Verify malaria raster access, annual coverage and whether environmental covariates overlap with land-cover predictors.
